_comment: Default ComfyUI API-format txt2img graph for a small-VRAM card. Renders a %latent_width%x%latent_height% latent (bounded by COMFYUI_LATENT_MAX_PIXELS, 512x512 by default - what a GTX 1060 3GB is verified to fit) and upscales to the requested %width%x%height% inside the graph, so the pipeline's 1080p request is honoured without asking the GPU for a 1080p latent. Core nodes only; no extra custom nodes or upscale models required. %model% is the checkpoint the worker resolves (request, COMFYUI_MODEL, or the first installed). Point COMFYUI_WORKFLOW at your own copy to use a different graph without touching code.
